Street Medics FR

Street Medics FR — Secours de rue. Alerte les street medics à proximité en cas d'urgence. 100% open source, OpenStreetMap uniquement.

Currently it serves 2 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://zaccariadev.github.io/street-medics-fdroid/fdroid/repo
